name: NAWA World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: The wing's top singles title, one of four named in its own March 1998 recruitment ad; no reign or holder survives in this pass's own holdings.
notes: Named, not structured with a reign, in the fed's own recruitment post (4 March 1998).
